environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.3.3 (swiftlang-6.3.3.1.3 clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx26.0

method.calibration: each variant independently targets requested duration; normalized per lookup; minimum one batch
method.configuration: SwiftPM release, Swift 6 mode; IlliquidApp -enable-testing for internal benchmark access
method.exclusions: all tab/query construction, Codable decoding, oracle, warmup, final checks, and JSON encoding are untimed
method.modules: unaltered production excerpt plus imports, separate IlliquidCore and IlliquidApp modules; no cross-module optimization
method.observability: preallocated exact boolean outputs plus weighted checksum from every timed batch
method.sampling: fresh processes, rotated workload order, balanced baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline pairs
method.scope: in-memory source-tab membership; no filesystem scan, UI, decode, playback, or energy measurement
method.timers: DispatchTime monotonic wall time and CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID around repeated 16-query batches; includes loop, Boolean stores, checksum updates and timer overhead; no empty-loop subtraction
